title: Lex's Combat Improvements
description: This mod changes the crosshair, and gives the ability to zoom
body:
This mods adds improvements for minecraft PvP or PvE combat, this is a client-side mod.

---------------

Note: This mod was made using the built in AI coder in Intellij, i do not take credit for the 
code whatshowever. i only promted it.

-----

### Features
This mod changes your crosshair depending on what you are looking at, the diferrent crosshairs are for:
- Looking at an entity
- Looking at a mineable block
- Looking at an interactable block (For example a chest)
- Having a bow or crossbow in your hand
- Aiming with your bow or crossbow

Another feature in this mod is zooming, when pressing c (or if you change it another keybind), you can change how zoomed in you are by scrolling

This mod also features a brightness change setting, but it currently doesn't work that well.
